area: O2 prerequisite attribution; no generation optimization claimed
hypothesis: Measure real replay/dependency/sampling work before choosing batching or cache changes; avoid interpreting cfg(test)-only zero counters as absence.
decision: Retain bounded opt-in summary/detailed capture and measurement-window CLI. Do not add raw sampling batching for the measured vanilla Nether workload. O2 work reduction still pending: use measured occupancy for a separate bounded view-cache experiment.
production_behavior: Capture disabled by default; no diagnostic allocation, clock or capture lock at disabled hooks; constructor checks env once per planner. Normal generation results and backend/default choices unchanged.

baseline.equivalence: Current base has the same native source tree and Cargo configuration; later commits were benchmark documentation.

notes: Unobserved zero totals mean not measured, not no work.
Inclusive recursive/concurrent host spans cannot be added into elapsed shares or GPU utilization.
View bytes are cumulative requested slot payload, exclude allocator metadata and column storage, and are not peak RSS.
Successful prefix outcomes use existing equality/empty-edit decisions and add no Arc owners.
Summary has per-prefix atomic observations and per-view inventory work; instrumented wall time is not headline speed evidence.
Detailed mode adds per-column clocks and a capture mutex and substantially perturbs hot paths.
Capture closure does not prove whole-generation success.
Trace is scoped to the ordered dependency planner; the measured vanilla Overworld path produced no captures.
Raw sampling hooks did not run in these actual vanilla Nether captures; positive raw query key/abort semantics are covered by unit tests, not a real GPU sampling trace.

cpu.scope: Production complete-region A/B, timed phases exclude comparison and snapshot/hash work; direct-owner scoped activity equal in both variants; does not prove scheduler normalization. Small-sample p95 is descriptive.

metal.scope: Production complete-region A/B, timed phases exclude comparison and snapshot/hash work; direct-owner scoped activity equal in both variants; does not prove scheduler normalization. Small-sample p95 is descriptive.

default_off_controls.decision: No runtime speedup claim; CPU timing inconclusive, Metal throughput difference below 1% with narrow descriptive bootstrap interval. Both are uninstrumented compared outputs.

coverage.warmups: 28 completed warmups outside measurements, from actual controllers/commands

process_cpu.scope: Process user/kernel deltas for the whole process and all its threads around the measured batch, including executor creation/join and host driver work. Excludes startup, warmups, readiness wait and later snapshot/hash/NBT validation work. GPU device execution and other processes are not CPU time here. Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.
